# Which box sizes should you stock?

> Free shipping box size optimizer for online sellers. Enter your products and the cartons you could buy; it solves which 1 to 10 box sizes to stock so every order ships in its cheapest fitting box, counting dimensional weight, box cost and void fill. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

- [How many box sizes to stock, and why the answer is a curve](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/shipping-box-size-optimizer/how-many-box-sizes-to-stock.html)
